text.EN: You're welcome. It's good to see you too.
text.TL: Walang anuman. Mabuti at nakita rin kita.
Kahit kailan. Masaya akong nandito ka.

text.EN: Always glad to talk. Stay safe out there.
text.TL: Palaging masayang makausap ka. Mag-ingat ka sa labas.

text.EN: No problem. Holler if you need a hand.
text.TL: Walang problema. Tawagin mo ako kapag kailangan mo ng tulong.

text.EN: Anytime, friend. Take care of yourself.
text.TL: Kahit kailan, kaibigan. Alagaan mo ang sarili mo.

text.EN: Glad we caught up. Catch you in a bit.
text.TL: Mabuti at nagkausap tayo. Magkita tayo mamaya.

text.EN: No trouble at all. Good to have you around.
text.TL: Walang problema talaga. Mabuti at nandito ka.

text.EN: Sure thing. Watch yourself out there, alright?
text.TL: Oo naman. Mag-ingat ka sa labas, ha?

text.EN: Take care. We'll talk again soon.
text.TL: Mag-iingat ka. Mag-usap tayo ulit mamaya.

text.EN: Always. Glad to see you on your feet.
text.TL: Palagi. Masaya akong maayos ang lagay mo.
